layerTypes.name: ui

layerTypes.name: bus

moduleTypes.name: mobile component

moduleTypes.name: bff
moduleTypes.description: A backend-for-frontend module that shapes APIs for a specific client experience.

moduleTypes.name: api
moduleTypes.description: A programmatic API module exposed to product clients, partners, or other systems.

moduleTypes.name: backoffice interface
moduleTypes.description: An internal operations or administration interface module.

moduleTypes.name: message queue
moduleTypes.description: A queue module used for asynchronous communication between modules or systems.

moduleTypes.name: message consumer
moduleTypes.description: A consumer module that processes messages or events from a bus.

moduleTypes.name: daemon
moduleTypes.description: A background worker or daemon module.

moduleTypes.name: stateless service
moduleTypes.description: A service module that orchestrates work without owning durable state.

moduleTypes.name: stateful service
moduleTypes.description: A service module that owns or manages persistent state, such as a database, stored domain data, or durable business records.

moduleTypes.name: service
moduleTypes.description: A domain or platform service module; prefer stateful-service or stateless-service for new modules when the state boundary is known.

moduleTypes.name: integration
moduleTypes.description: A connector or adapter module for an external system, partner, device, or platform.
